messages:
claire: PR #3901 preview failed CI — linkcheck + markdown-lint + vale. Can someone help triage quickly so we can hit the midday docs cut?
mike: can you paste the failing lines or the snippet? linkcheck usually prints the broken URL.
claire: linkcheck shows "http://internal.setup.local/quickstart" -> 404 (internal-only). markdown-lint: MD013 (line length) on the migration note. vale: warns about passive voice and weasel words ("simply", "easy"). also spellcheck flagged "envrionment" in the example.
dev-ci-bot: docs-preview failed for PR #3901 — linkcheck: 1 error, markdown-lint: 1 error, vale: 2 warnings, spellcheck: 1. Full log: https://ci.redwood/preview/3901
mike: for internal links we usually point to the public mirror under docs.redwood.ai or add a note. simplest: swap to https://docs.redwood.ai/setup-quickstart for now.
claire: ok i can do that. for the long line i'll split the sentence and remove the word "simply". also fix the typo.
mike: also tag the code fence with ```bash — untagged fences sometimes break syntax highlight in preview. e.g. replace:
```
redwood migrate --from v1 --to v2 --force
```
with:
```bash
redwood migrate --from v1 --to v2 --force
```
claire: pushing fix now: swapped URL, split long line, fixed typo, added ```bash tag. https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/3901/files
dev-ci-bot: Re-run triggered for PR #3901. Results: linkcheck: PASS, markdown-lint: PASS, vale: WARN (1 suggestion: avoid "utilise" -> use "use"), spellcheck: PASS. Preview deployed: ✅
oliver: quick review — looks good. LGTM. Please merge before the docs freeze at 16:00 UTC. :rocket:
claire: thanks all — merged and added a changelog note. :tada:
